chemometrics_note: A quantitative moisture model (e.g. PLS) will need a representative calibration set spanning the moisture range and physical variation, preprocessing for scatter (e.g. derivatives or SNV-type correction), and validation on held-out batches; the reference method's uncertainty bounds the achievable accuracy.
realtime_tracking_note: If the measurement is installed in-line, continuous tracking of moisture trends is feasible with fiber-optic NIR, but release-testing use additionally requires the customer's validated procedure and regulatory acceptance.
future_direction: Once the calibration is established, a simplified multi-wavelength LED-type NIR sensor could be considered for routine monitoring, following the published concept.

proposal.what_would_change_it: The answers on moisture range, granulate character and reference method could shift the choice between reflection and transflection geometry, and a failed feasibility trial against the customer's tolerance would end the NIR route.

brief_answer: We cannot confirm in writing a ±0.1 % moisture accuracy or promise your regulator's approval: no accuracy figure is supported by the available material, and approval depends on your own validation dossier. Pricing likewise cannot be quoted before the configuration is defined. What we can propose is a feasibility trial: NIR diffuse-reflection spectra on representative granulate samples, calibrated against your reference moisture method and validated on held-out batches. Please share the moisture range, granulate character, reference method and installation point.
